mplstyle: matplotlib default; no repo style sheet
curve: mean(stat_bar - stat_DMO)/mean(stat_DMO); empty DMO bins masked
noise_seeds: MATCHED between baryonified and DMO, AND shared between the BNT and standard suites, so the two series differ only by the nulling transform (jobs 533505/536722 standard, 536997/536998 BNT)
caveats: Bin 1 is expected to coincide between the two bases: the BNT matrix's first row is the identity, so BNT bin 1 IS standard bin 1. Agreement there is a correctness check.
No +5 offset in the HOS denominator; empty bins are masked instead.
y-range is fitted to the CURVES; the near-empty end bins have bands far larger.
Band scaled to survey area by 1/sqrt(f_sky) -- indicative for the HOS, which have no mode-counting result behind them.
